answer_1.quote: We develop and evaluate strategies to control an LLM to use developmentally beneficial grammar forms when generating dialogue responses ...
answer_1.outputs: Chatbot dialogue responses containing specified grammar skills

answer_2.quote: To evaluate these strategies, we measure the presence of grammar forms, response quality, and efficiency ... We prompt gpt-4o to rate the response ... in terms of Appropriateness, Relevance, Content Richness and Grammatical Correctness ... We also use distinct-2 and inference speed.
automatic_metrics: Grammar constraint satisfaction (presence of specified grammar forms)

answer_3.quote: We prompt gpt-4o-2024-08-06 for quality evaluation ... the prompt asks GPT-4o to rate the response, given a preceding dialog, in terms of one of the four dimensions with a score from 1 to 5.
methods: Prompted rating of generated responses using GPT-4o
